summary.goal: Implement REST endpoints for creating, reading, updating, and listing plans
summary.context: Core API surface for plan management. Supports creating new plans, fetching by ID, updating drafts, and listing with filters.

acceptance_criteria.description: POST /plans creates new plan with draft version
GET /plans lists plans with optional status filter
GET /plans/:id returns latest version
GET /plans/:id/versions lists all versions
GET /plans/:id/versions/:version returns specific version
PUT /plans/:id updates draft version (rejects if approved)
POST /plans/:id/versions creates new version from existing
All endpoints return proper status codes and JSON responses

steps.title: Set up Express server structure
steps.description: Create src/api/ directory with Express app setup, middleware (JSON parsing, error handling).

acceptance_criteria.description: Express app created with JSON middleware
Error handling middleware returns consistent JSON errors
CORS configured for development

steps.title: Define request/response schemas
steps.description: Create Zod schemas for API request bodies and response shapes.

acceptance_criteria.description: CreatePlanRequest schema: goal (required), context (optional)
UpdatePlanRequest schema: goal, context, steps changes
Response schemas for plan, version, error

steps.title: Implement POST /plans endpoint
steps.description: Create endpoint to create new plan with initial draft version.

acceptance_criteria.description: Accepts goal and optional context in body
Creates plan and version in storage
Returns 201 with created plan and version
Validates request body with Zod

steps.title: Implement GET /plans endpoint
steps.description: Create endpoint to list plans with optional status filter.

acceptance_criteria.description: Returns array of plans
Supports ?status= query parameter
Returns 200 with empty array if no plans

steps.title: Implement GET /plans/:id endpoint
steps.description: Create endpoint to get plan with its latest version.

acceptance_criteria.description: Returns plan with latest version attached
Returns 404 if plan not found
Includes full version with steps

steps.title: Implement version list and get endpoints

acceptance_criteria.description: List returns all versions for plan
Get returns specific version by number
Returns 404 if version not found

steps.title: Implement PUT /plans/:id endpoint
steps.description: Create endpoint to update draft version of a plan.

acceptance_criteria.description: Updates goal, context, or steps of draft version
Returns 400 if latest version is approved/published
Returns 200 with updated version

steps.title: Implement POST /plans/:id/versions endpoint
steps.description: Create endpoint to create new version from existing version.

acceptance_criteria.description: Creates new draft version based on latest
Increments version number
Returns 201 with new version

steps.title: Add integration tests for CRUD endpoints
steps.description: Write integration tests using supertest for all CRUD endpoints.

acceptance_criteria.description: Tests cover all endpoints
Tests verify correct status codes
Tests verify error responses
All tests pass
